pr_title: Validate if tests in test/e2e/common/storage/volume.go are still needed
pr_body:

https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-release/release.md#issuepr-kind-label
3. Ensure you have added or ran the appropriate tests for your PR: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-testing/testing.md
4. If you want *faster* PR reviews, read how: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#best-practices-for-faster-reviews
5. If the PR is unfinished, see how to mark it: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#marking-unfinished-pull-requests
-->

#### What type of PR is this?
/kind cleanup
/sig storage
<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature
/kind design

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Checks if the tests in test/e2e/common/storage/volume.go are still needed

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #99468

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

The answer is yes, they are still needed. I looked at all the other tests and found no tests that use any of the logic.
While searching for the test logic in other tests I also found the following:

Remove comment:
```
// GlusterFS test is duplicated from test/e2e/volumes.go.  Any changes made there
// should be duplicated here
```
There is no file test/e2e/volumes.go
I could also not the mentioned tests anywhere. This must mean that this file is the only place where this logic is tested.

On line 97
```
// Must match content of test/images/volumes-tester/nfs/index.html
```
directory `test/images/volumes-tester` does not exists, `test/images/volume` does.

The same goes for line 146
```
// 'test_vol' comes from test/images/volumes-tester/gluster/run_gluster.sh
```
Additionally, I could not find `test_vol` in that file (`test/images/volume/gluster/run_gluster.sh`)

The same goes for line 151 
```
// Must match content of test/images/volumes-tester/gluster/index.html
```
(content still matched)

The same goes for the comment
```
// Must match content of test/images/volumes-tester/gluster/index.html
```
(content still matched)

In file `test/e2e/storage/testsuite/volumes.go` the following comment:
```
// test/e2e/common/volumes.go duplicates the GlusterFS test from this file.  Any changes made to this
// test should be made there as well.
```
is therefore also not needed anymore

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

If no, just write "NONE" in the release-note block below.
If yes, a release note is required:
Enter your extended release note in the block below. If the PR requires additional action from users switching to the new release, include the string "action required".

For more information on release notes see: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/release-notes.md
-->

```release-note
NONE
```

review_comments:
We have "should store data" tests that run against nfs and gluster:
https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/sig-storage-kubernetes#gce&include-filter-by-regex=should%20store%20data&include-filter-by-regex=nfs%7Cgluster

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/2170bba47a123ce823284d724cf673349c6aa378/test/e2e/storage/testsuites/volumes.go#L156

I think they are pretty similar and we could potentially get rid of the ones under "common/storage/volumes.go". I think the only thing that may be missing is a config for nfs v3. We may have to add another config under https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/e2e/storage/drivers/in_tree.go#L95

Thank you for your reaction!

To verify, you suggest 

* removing the tests from `test/e2e/common/storage/volumes.go`
* And one of two options:
1. Adding a test function with config for nfs v3 at `test/e2e/storage/drivers/in_tree.go` (at the bottom of the file?).
2. Adding a test config for v3 to `SupportedFsType` at `func InitNFSDriver() storageframework.TestDriver` at line 95 from `test/e2e/storage/drivers/in_tree.go` .

Is this correct? If so, I'll directly do this and update the PR.
Yeah, I would go with the first approach for adding a nfsv3 driver config
